r31.remaining_readiness: All 23 R31 specifications remain marked INCOMPLETE until their individual documented derivation, source-level review, full boundary cases, renderer binding and visual/runtime evidence are closed.

historical_records.interpretation: This is a complete inventory and documentation pass against the preserved manifest/register. It is not a claim that all 472 techniques have been independently researched, implemented or certified.

manifest_readiness.gate_meaning: PASS means the audit ran successfully and no incomplete item was falsely promoted to IMPLEMENTATION_READY. It does not mean the 495 incomplete records are certified.
